notes: Background: mid-market product analytics SaaS (B2B) looking to add in-product chat + smarter support triage using embeddings + reranking.
Started on Hosted API in Jan 2026 for quick POC (chat + embeddings). Response: fast onboarding, low friction. POC showed 30% reduction in avg handle time for support flows.
Current ask: move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation once we hit production. Primary drivers: steady peak traffic, cost predictability, and VPC requirement.
Pricing convo: AE presented two committed tiers (reserved vGPU hours) + burst credits. Customer prefers commit + ramp schedule vs large up-front commit.
Key negotiation items: commit level (8x A100-equivalent GPUs), burst policy (2x for 2 weeks/month), overage rate structure (discounted vs on-demand), and 12 vs 24 month ramp schedule.
Customer quote: 'We like the predictable unit economics but can't up-front commit 24 months at top tier — need staged ramp tied to usage metrics.'

Security: requires SSO/SAML, SOC2 evidence, KMS integration, audit logs, and EU data residency for a subset of customers — currently evaluating Private for residency but prefer VPC Dedicated if possible.
POC artifacts: pricing deck v3, security FAQ shared, Fireflies demo recordings linked. SE ran latency/throughput stress test (see INF-9876 ticket).
Procurement timeline: procurement cycle closes end of May; legal wants SOW and clear overage clauses; finance wants quarterly ramp payments, not single annual payment.
AE notes: flexible on burst windows and overage caps if commit level increases; suggested 3-month ramp (25% -> 50% -> 100%) or option for auto-scale burst with capped monthly cost.
CS interaction: CSM not assigned yet; plan to add CSM on contract signature for onboarding and runbooks.
Open items: exact SLA numbers for p95 < 500ms on short-context chat, final ARR commitment, clear billing schedule (monthly vs quarterly invoice).
